system.longDesc: By training or raw talent, your unarmed strikes leave a lasting impression.

degree0.desc: When you attack unarmed, you inflict 1d6 damage instead of 1d3.

degree1.desc: Your punch can drop the toughest opponents. You can perform the Knock Prone stunt for 1 SP when attacking unarmed.

degree2.desc: You can perform the Injure or Vicious Blow action stunts for 1 SP when attacking unarmed.
